# Kakure Prime

> Kakure Prime is a confidential treasury and settlement layer for tokenized equities on Solana.

Kakure Prime lets funds, DAOs, family offices, and companies hold and move Token-2022 equities without publicly revealing portfolio amounts, recipients, or signer activity. Solana programs verify Groth16 zero-knowledge proofs while dealerless FROST threshold custody prevents any single signer from moving assets alone.

## Core capabilities

- Shield AAPLx, TSLAx, NVDAx, SPYx, and other supported SPL or Token-2022 assets.
- Require configurable threshold approval for private portfolio movements.
- Settle with commitments and nullifiers verified by an on-chain Solana program.
- Give recipients private claim links for wallet withdrawal.
- Enable selective audit access through a separate threshold compliance committee.

## Technical architecture

- Seven Noir circuits compiled to Groth16.
- Native Solana pool program with verifier CPIs, commitment tree, nullifiers, and asset vaults.
- Dealerless FROST DKG and threshold signing.
- SDK, CLI, indexer, encrypted coordinator, local prover, WASM prover, and React web application.

## Status

Kakure Prime is an unaudited pre-release localnet/devnet demonstration. It uses development Groth16 setup parameters and must not hold real funds or securities.
